question: Does the fixed BR1 controlled display-tone curve remain visible, monotone and artifact-safe on independent photographs when executed as a bounded explicit Lab lightness residual?

population.role: independent photographic stress; no fitting, selection or threshold tuning

operator.input: display-referred sRGB decoded to linear-sRGB then D65 CIELAB
operator.target: replace L-star with the fixed BR1 full-fit PCHIP while preserving a-star and b-star
operator.gamut_policy: fixed 24-iteration source-to-target Lab segment compression in linear-sRGB

selection_rule: if every automatic and severe visual gate passes, retain BR1 only as a bounded controlled-tone component for a later factorized ablation; otherwise close without curve, strength, gamut-policy, population or threshold rescue
claim_ceiling: photographic stress evidence for one fixed publication-derived display-tone component; not Velvia sensitometry, scene exposure response, scanner-independent stock tone, full film style, calibrated reference or product promotion
